messages:
zoe: Draft PR 2564 ready for a quick docs sweep — focused on invocation envelopes, a tiny JSON schema, and short SDK examples (py/js). Looking for clarity and any migration notes we should call out.

arjun: Happy to review. Does the PR use the new `invocations` field name everywhere? Last migration left a couple legacy mentions.

zoe: I think so, but double-checking. The schema intentionally keeps `meta` nullable to reduce guard boilerplate for callers. Small excerpt in the doc: 

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "command": {"type": "string"},
    "args": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "meta": {"anyOf": [{"type": "object"}, {"type": "null"}]},
    "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ok", "error"]}
  },
  "required": ["command", "status"]
}
```

frank: Schema looks fine. Two suggestions: 1) add a one-line callout that the runtime can include transient top-level keys (don't force additionalProperties in the example), 2) include a tiny normalize helper in JS so teams copy less defensive code.

zoe: Good calls. I added a short sentence ("the runtime may attach ephemeral top-level keys; prefer extracting expected fields") and this JS helper: 

```js
function normalizeOutput(resp) {
  const out = resp.invocations?.[0]?.output || {};
  return {
    command: out.command,
    args: out.args || [],
    meta: out.meta ?? {},
    status: out.status
  }
}
```

maya: For Python please include an idiomatic safe-access example (no KeyError), e.g.: 

```py
inv = resp.get('invocations', [])
out = inv[0].get('output', {}) if inv else {}
result = {
  'command': out.get('command'),
  'args': out.get('args', []),
  'meta': out.get('meta') or {},
  'status': out.get('status')
}
```

arjun: Also a short parse-fallback snippet for non-JSON output would be helpful. Maybe pseudo-code so we don't prescribe implementation: 

```
try:
  parsed = json.loads(text)
except ValueError:
  parsed = try_field_extraction(text)  # e.g., regex or heuristics
```

zoe: Added that as a tiny pseudo-code block and linked to the parse-runbook. link-bot: link-check: two warnings — one internal runbook alias is outdated, one broken reference to an old SDK example.

frank: I'll take the runbook link; arjun can you sweep the examples for the old SDK reference?

arjun: On it. Found one stray `tools` in an image caption; fixing now.

frank: Updated the runbook link to the canonical path and pushed. link-bot: re-run link-check: warnings cleared.

maya: Minor copy nit: change "may attach" -> "might include" to match style guide. Otherwise +1 for content.

arjun: +1 for schema and snippets after caption fix.

zoe: Thanks all — I'll merge after CI green. Will add a short changelog entry and paste the sandbox link for the SDK snippets after landing. :sparkles:
